{{Attr|Corpse}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mimic Umbra''' is a large enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health, somewhat high defense and an above average speed. It has two immunities, the [[Burn Immunity]], which makes it immune to being set on fire, and the [[Stun Immunity]], which prevents it from getting stunned, being only slowed down instead and prevents it from being knocked back. It also has [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]], making it turn into a [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] on death. ==Appearance== The '''Mimic Umbra''' is a plushie that resembles [[The Umbra]]. The '''Mimic Umbra''' has black skin and hair with buns. It wears a magenta chestplate and leggings, with yellow patterns on them, black shoes and clothing. It also wears a purple crown with yellow headpieces. It has yellow buttons for eyes. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |6% |960 |- !Wave !Health |- |32 |16,960 |- |33 |17,920 |- |34 |18,880 |- |35 |19,840 |- |36 |20,800 |- |37 |21,760 |- |38 |22,720 |- |39 |23,680 |- |40 |24,640 |} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] are very useful against this. **Additionally, you can use [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers' firerate and range, respectively. *Freezing towers can be quite effective against the '''Mimic Umbra''', as it is not immune to freeze. **Because of its [[Stun Immunity]], the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it. Additionally, the [[Warden]] will only slow it down for a shorter amount of time because of its size. **It cannot be knocked back by knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] as it has the [[Stun Immunity]]. *Defense dropping towers, such as the [[Freezer]], [[Cryomancer]] or [[Electroshocker]], can be useful against the '''Mimic Umbra''' due to its somewhat high defense. **Towers that reduce defense through burn, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Molten Monster]], cannot be used to drop its defense due to the '''Mimic Umbra''' having the [[Burn Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMimicUmbra.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- 🎄 Christmas Trailer 🎄|'''Mimic Umbra''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMimicUmbra.png|'''Mimic Umbra''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Mimic Umbra''' is a call-back to the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]'s [[The Umbra]]. *The '''Mimic Umbra''' having 16,000 health is a reference to [[The Umbra]]'s debut in [[Totality Tower]] being Wave 16. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2022''' -
